name: kite-pos
description: A point of sale for a corner shop: a Hono Worker over D1 and R2, and two Kite PWAs.

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=@kite-pos/api & npm run dev --workspace=@kite-pos/app
scripts.check: npm run typecheck --workspace=@kite-pos/api && npm run check --workspace=@kite-pos/app
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=@kite-pos/api && npm run test --workspace=@kite-pos/app
scripts.deploy:app: npm run build --workspace=@kite-pos/app && npm run deploy --workspace=@kite-pos/app

//allowScripts: Hoisted from both workspaces. Each fetches a platform binary its tool is useless without: esbuild bundles, and workerd is the runtime `wrangler dev` runs the Worker in.
